name: Stable Audio 3 Medium — text to audio
title: Make music or sound effects
summary: Describe the music, loop or sound effect you want and get it in seconds, up to five minutes long. Instrumental only: it does not sing.
description:
Generate music, instrument loops, sound effects, or one-shots from a short text description. Pick a Category, type what you want (e.g. "lofi hip-hop chill beat with mellow Rhodes and vinyl crackle"), set a duration, and play the result.

'Enhance prompt with AI' is off, and should stay off on this ComfyUI build: its Qwen 3.5 rewrite fails with "Unsupported Flash Attention tensor strides". Write the full description yourself, the way Stability's guide recommends: genre first, then instruments, mood, production and tempo (BPM) — or a plain description of one sound effect. The Category menu only steers that AI rewrite, so it has no effect while the enhancer is off. It does not sing.
